## Ice and Sun: Argentina and Brazil

This itinerary takes you through two countries and four very different places. Start in Buenos Aires, with its historic neighbourhoods, broad avenues and tango. Then head to Patagonia and the Perito Moreno Glacier. At Iguazú, you’ll see the falls from both the Argentine and Brazilian sides. Finish in Rio de Janeiro, where the ocean meets granite mountains, including Sugarloaf and Corcovado.
